description: Defines the data models for recipes and ingredients, including serialization and deserialization methods for JSON conversion.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: Represents an ingredient with a name and quantity, including methods for mapping to and from a map.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a recipe with various properties such as id, title, description, ingredients, steps, and more, with serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: Ingredient.fromMap
methods.description: Creates an Ingredient instance from a map.

methods.name: Ingredient.toMap
methods.description: Converts an Ingredient instance to a map.

methods.name: Recipe.fromMap
methods.description: Creates a Recipe instance from a map, processing nested ingredients and other properties.

methods.name: Recipe.toMap
methods.description: Converts a Recipe instance to a map, including serializing ingredients.

methods.name: Recipe.toJson
methods.description: Converts a Recipe instance to a JSON string.

methods.name: Recipe.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Recipe instance from a JSON string.
